boundaries: A actual packaged App after normal full-process quit/restart, production SQLite workspace and native recovery. Public project/roots/open/checkpoint/saveWorkspace only seed own legacy duplicate aliases and private native drafts before UI restoration. Test UI uses pointer/keyboard and actual Save/close/reopen/restore. Original open/read/save observer is passive and restored. Read-only public draft inspection, no Store/editor mutation, fabricated receipts, external host/network, clipboard, model or daily data.

A packaged App normal full-process quit/restart, real A/B tree selection and original root/file/native IO. Missing physical directory and public remove original registration are fault preconditions. Restore only exact removed project_dirs row in own disposable SQLite as an external configuration change in the own disposable DB; no document/checkpoint/credentials edits. Genuine original open success held unchanged during explicit retry, then actual user B selection/edit/save. No private Store/editor/results injection, clipboard, external App, model or daily data.

D22 deterministic canonical tab merge uses existing approved manual recovery entry for independent old alias versions. Direct per-path draft namespace and original-source identity validation remain unchanged; no false claim that both aliases must expose same inline button list.

D24 covers removed original registration and missing original directory; exact source id/path restored only as fault precondition, actual UI Retry performs fresh original RPC/native authority, A original read held unchanged and B remains selected/dirty until explicit save. No D23 clipboard/external-opening result claimed.

U2 completion-order and foreign-host isolation; real SQLite/native alias I2; U3 missing/path-changed/late original recovery; real registered-source/native D24 I2. File identity ref fields, not JS object pointer, are authoritative.

Existing retry/recovery/placeholder visual design unchanged; no prototype source or full reference/pixel verification claim. Full goal419 preserved; all unrelated manual/system, platform and P/V cases remain independent.

Original red/driver errors and stale-test regression retained. Final build/prod source equal, only external observations/tests changed after build. Local r59 unsigned0.0.5 and all own Apps stopped; no daily AIS, credentials, Codex, clipboard or release operation.
